title: Introduce a new Menu UI to resolve memory issues and improve user experience

latest.text: The rebase was to check if anything needed updating due to the HTMX 4 upgrade.

I built a recipe to stress test this. Just a mere 15,000 menu links in a nice hierarchy. AI gave some suggestions: https://github.com/mgifford/drupal-core-lab/blob/main/reports/issues/359... ChatGPT gave it a few warnings: https://github.co

Thanks very much for the review @mgifford. Your bot uncovered some interesting issues and I've gone down a couple of rabbit holes making improvements off the back of them. I'll report in when that's done.
